about: The grep gates qa/lint.mjs runs. Owner: WP-0B (DESIGN 2.2 WP-0B lint rules, 4.11 integrity checks).

A rule runs in `node qa/lint.mjs` only while `active` is true. Each starts inactive until the merge of the package named in `activatedBy`, the one whose work makes it pass; the integrator flips it on at that merge. `node qa/lint.mjs --all` reports every rule, active or not.

files and except are globs from the game root (* within a folder, ** across folders). A file that does not exist yet is simply not checked, so a rule over modules still to be written covers each one from the day it lands.
scope: code (comments, string text and regex bodies blanked: only code can match), nocomment (comments blanked, strings kept), raw (the whole file).

pattern or patterns: JavaScript regular expressions (flag u), matched line by line. allowLine: a match on a line that also matches this is allowed. allowIn: a match inside a function with one of these names is allowed. marker: a match on a line carrying this text (in a comment) is allowed.

rules.what: No Math.random in a pure module: every random draw comes from the seeded RNG passed in (rng.js), so a seed reproduces a match.
No S., MT, A., window. or document. (or globalThis.) in a pure module: everything comes in through arguments, and only bridge.js touches the classic globals.

rules.ref: DESIGN header ("Pure means a module with no THREE, no DOM and no classic global access"), 1.2
rules.what: No THREE in a pure module, and no import of three.js: pure modules run under plain node for the unit tests and the harness.
bridge.js does not import W from ../build.js, so a bare W in it is the classic world data (js/world.js), never the 3D scene's.
No Ctrl, Alt or Meta gameplay binding in js/life/football: the only use allowed is the guard that ignores a key pressed with a modifier (if (ev.ctrlKey || ev.altKey || ev.metaKey) return ...).
No new MeshStandardMaterial outside build.js, human.js, sky.js and crowd.js: materials come from mat() and carry userData.spec, so a preset change can rematerialise them.

rules.ref: DESIGN D18 (no legacy flag ships), 2.5 WP-L
rules.what: No legacyMatch flag or path anywhere in the game: the 2D engine is retired, not kept behind a switch.
One ball integrator: no stepBall in js/life, and ballStep is defined only in js/life/football/ball.js.

rules.ref: DESIGN 1.3 (trust single owner), 2.3 WP-G and WP-T1 acceptance, 4.11
rules.what: Trust changes only through trustAdd (daily.js); the load-time clamp in dailyEnsure is the one other write. The admin editor sets values directly by design. js/engine goes with WP-L.
S.inv changes only in consume(), parcelStep and the shops (buyFood, shopBuy, the hub's buy); dailyEnsure only normalises it on load. The admin editor sets values directly by design.
No literal "10:00 AM", "4:00 PM" or "5:00 PM" in js/life and js/ui: copy reads the hours from the constants through fmtTime and fmtRange.
The 2D engine and the dream are gone: no startMoment, renderMatchScreen, matchSkillsOn, startDream, legacyMatch, loco=old, #pitch or js/engine/ anywhere in the game.
Every js/life/**/*.js module has an importmap entry in index.html, so a returning player never runs a new module against a cached one.
